title: Stop at the demo room's box and do not detour on its own
description: The TurtleBot3 twin starts in the demo room 0.75 m behind a box and is asked, through the Generic ROS 2 Adapter over rosbridge, to advance 1.2 m. It must stop short of the box with the 0.35 m LiDAR floor held, report obstacle_blocked as a failed call, send no goal but the one DriveOnHeading it was asked for (no NavigateToPose, NavigateThroughPoses, BackUp or Spin: no detour and no recovery of its own), and stay still with no further motion command afterwards. A detour is the caller's decision, never the adapter's.
